//@version=5
indicator("RSI")
length = input(14)
rsi = ta.rsi(close, length)
sma20 = ta.sma(close, 20)
plot(rsi)
plot(sma20)
highest3 = ta.highest(close, 3)
lowest3 = ta.lowest(close, 3)
is_missing = na(close)
filled = nz(close)
source_cci = ta.cci(open, 3)
source_vwap = ta.vwap(open)
psar = ta.sar(0.02, 0.03, 0.2)
[plus_di, minus_di, adx] = ta.dmi(3, 3)
change1 = ta.change(close)
[aroon_up, aroon_down] = ta.aroon(3)
stoch_fast = ta.stoch(close, high, low, 3)
